items.title: Main Light Source
items.body:
# Primary Light

This is the main light source that illuminates various materials in our thought space.

## Properties
- High intensity
- Broad spectrum
- Can be toggled on/off

items.title: Secondary Light
items.body:
# Secondary Light

A supporting light source for additional perspectives.

- Lower intensity
- Focused beam
- Complements main light

items.title: Core Concept
items.body:
# Core Concept

This represents a fundamental idea or concept that can be examined from different angles.

## Details
- Central to the thought process
- Can cast shadows when illuminated
- Connects to other concepts

items.title: Supporting Idea
items.body:
# Supporting Idea

A secondary concept that supports or relates to the core concept.

- Provides additional context
- Can be projected by multiple lights
- May have connections to other materials

items.title: Research Notes
items.body:
# Research Notes

## Key Findings
- Finding 1: Important discovery
- Finding 2: Related observation
- Finding 3: Future direction

## References
- Source A
- Source B
- Source C

items.title: Implication A
items.body:
# Implication A

This represents a shadow or implication cast by the core concept when viewed through the main light.

- Derived from core concept
- Specific perspective
- Action item or conclusion

items.title: Alternative View
items.body:
# Alternative View

An alternative perspective or shadow cast by the supporting idea.

- Different interpretation
- Counter-argument
- Additional consideration
